title: Can My Viewers BEAT Me with Odds? [VOD 1]
summary: VOD of his first livestream (~68 min): viewers (rated ~200-1450) send custom challenges, often giving HIM odds (e.g. 'I don't have any minor pieces', down a queen), and he plays them in 3-minute-ish games while chatting, thanking Super Chats and members. Mix of heavy-odds losses/scrambles, some games with no odds, ending with a ladder-mate attempt and a sign-off.
rules: Each game is a custom challenge from a viewer; the challenger chooses the odds removed from the creator's side (e.g. no minor pieces; no queen) or no odds.
Normal chess rules; custom positions are unrated; short time controls without increment (~3 min).
win_condition: Checkmate/resign/time in each odds game; no fixed series goal.

opponent.name: Viewers (e.g. SpherePlays 792, oloh_flow 1446, a 200 and a 700)
opponent.avatar_description: Random viewer avatars; remake: rotating weak bots with chatty viewer names.

board.theme_notes: chess.com brown board with live chat panel beside it.

setup: Standard position minus the handicap chosen for the creator's side, e.g. no minor pieces: r1bqkb1r... for Black / R2QK2R for White with all pawns (handicap varies per game).
events: Random handicap per game (picked from: no minor pieces, no queen, no rooks, none).
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'botodds' removes pieces from the BOT; in the stream the odds are removed from the CREATOR's (player's) side by the viewer's choice.
evidence: SRT 0:00 'welcome to the Liv stream... you guys are going to be on the VOD'; 0:40 'you can challenge me to a game of odds so if you want to play with me down a queen you can make that happen'; 0:50 'that is heavy odds I don't have any minor pieces'; 1:00 'he's rated 700'; 8:10 'custom position is it automatically unrated'; 21:30 'I didn't even have odds this game'; 22:00 'this guy's rated 200'. Frames: SpherePlays (792), oloh_flow (1446), user 2002.
